context_files.purpose: Verbatim owner directive requiring paper-first scientific rigor without rushing or reducing the design.
Paper-ROI case for replacing the full repair with a minimal causal instrument and an early G1 falsifier.
High-assurance fallback and catalogue of oracle, chronology, provenance, isolation, and resource failures that a smaller protocol must still avoid.
Exact predecessor world used to audit target geometry, prospective support, Bayes conditioning, twins, and action semantics.
Unchanged G1 DEV contract for four pair-level units, target counts, reader budgets, controls, thresholds, and promotion boundaries.
Paper-facing causal ladder, action-world semantics, baselines, independent-unit definition, and claim limits.
Mandatory durable deliberation, exact human ratification, independent review, and scientific-compute authority boundary.

strongest_case: The paper-ROI argument for a new J/P-only instrument is strong: the immediate decision is whether one frozen resolver can exploit connected gold through a recurrent interface, not whether Candidate B is release-grade. The proposed finite algebra is also genuinely useful. The set F2^2 times 24 has 96 worlds; tau(c_v,c_i,A,b)=(c_v xor 1,c_i xor 1,A,b xor 01) is an involutive fixed-point-free map, flips both conditioner choices under complementary inventories, and changes every affine valve output by 01. Under an exact uniform hidden-independent generator, the two useful-item choices have four equal orientation completions; when the separately witnessed J valve mode is also unknown, the complete target-only plan has sixteen equal pair-plus-mode completions and Bayes value 1/16, not 1/4, while 1/4 is the value conditional on the valve atom. P can have an exact 1/4 schema-deletion value. These facts make a small exhaustive oracle plausible. They do not yet make the proposed 96-world protocol valid: global conditioner orientations destroy J's informational cross-era necessity, target-byte invariance and posterior masses still depend on an unspecified renderer/sampler, and the proposed OPEN_READ gap is created by a particular opaque-pointer interface rather than by the world. A corrected, narrowly claimed minimal protocol remains the best paper investment if those defects are resolved before implementation.

concerns.statement: The proposed 96-world family makes c_v and c_i global across old and current modules, so one era's complete setter panel determines the other era's setter mappings; J may require an old and a current cartridge physically while remaining solvable from current-era semantics alone.
concerns.evidence: The constructibility interpretation explicitly says each orientation bit determines complementary setter order across the old and current modules. E1 exposes all four current complementary mappings. Hence current history identifies both global bits and reconstructs the old useful family; the current witnessed valve relation supplies the remaining J fact. Conversely old history can reconstruct current setters. Removing cartridges or making APPLY illegal proves environmental dependence but cannot detect this informational shortcut. Replace the global bits with era-local orientations, for example (c_v_old,c_i_old,c_v_current,c_i_current), yielding at least 16 conditioner assignments times 24 valve laws = 384 worlds, or supply an equivalent exact construction whose old-only and current-only posteriors remain nonsingleton. Independently enumerate the two era-restricted history controllers; a mutation that re-globalizes either orientation must fail.

concerns.statement: The proposed exact J target-only value of 1/4 omits the independently unknown witnessed J valve mode, and the protocol does not distinguish ex-ante generator risk from a post-hoc optimum on the four frozen twin pairs.
concerns.evidence: With hidden-independent target bytes, the two useful item identities are a one-to-one function of two balanced orientation bits, giving four equal item-pair completions. Across the 24 affine laws, f(q)=Aq xor b is balanced over four modes and independent of the conditioner bits, so a target-only complete pair-plus-mode plan has 16 equal completions and value 1/16. Value 1/4 is correct only after conditioning on the J valve atom. More importantly, each realized byte-identical twin pair contains only two sides; a post-hoc policy allowed to memorize its unique target handle can choose one side's plan and score 1/2. The meaningful ceiling is therefore the Bayes value of a policy frozen before hidden tapes under the complete generative measure, not a supremum fit after the four-pair ledger is known. Consensus must bind the representative/orbit sampler, side weighting, target construction, handle factors, all public conditioning bytes, action ties, and both quantities separately. The exact number may be 1/16 rather than 1/4; the scientific requirement is a correctly derived value at most .35.

concerns.statement: Tau is algebraically valid, but preserving every target-visible byte is a property of the still-unspecified target constructor, renderer, ordering, and handle ledger, not of tau alone.
concerns.evidence: Applying tau twice returns the original world and b xor 01 changes f(q) by 01 for every descriptor, so the hidden transformation is fixed-point-free and changes the P mode. Complementary inventories can also make both J useful item identities change. But any hidden-conditioned family selection, target order, phrase, length, layout, handle draw/cursor, goal, acceptance receipt, or error path can reveal the side or make bytes differ. Freeze a direct no-rejection constructor, pair-common target-handle tape, canonical ordering independent of useful roles, literal action law, and complete renderer. Exhaustively byte-compare every J/P template in every hidden completion and require both useful J instances and every decisive valve mode to differ. Also verify that ordinary public life history, unlike the target, actually identifies the side.

concerns.statement: A same-law D11 confirmer observed before target creation can reveal the exact abstract D11 output needed by the distinct held-out D11 family, turning P into retrospective same-descriptor transfer even though the local family edge itself has no outcome record.
concerns.evidence: The interpretation identifies the affine law from D00,D01,D10, commits predictions, then publishes a balanced D11 confirmer panel before constructing a target on another D11 family governed by the same law. Distinct handles prevent literal family-edge lookup but do not prevent copying the now-witnessed D11-to-mode relation if descriptor/schema membership is public or inferable. The held-out edge being locally unwitnessed is weaker than the required prospective dependence. Confirm the commitment on distinct later roots at descriptors that do not disclose the held-out D11 output, or seal and evaluate the D11 target before any D11 confirming outcome. Preseal the held-out family and target template before commitment so later support cannot choose the target. The oracle must prove no pretarget record or same-descriptor relation closes the target.

concerns.statement: After full public source history identifies the affine law, the actual hidden-world posterior for P is singleton; the four equal modes arise only by deleting the schema/grammar relation and therefore must be labeled a registered content intervention, not a no-life or world posterior.
concerns.evidence: Three noncollinear descriptor points uniquely identify one of the 24 affine laws, and a D11 confirmer would make the output even more explicit. The proposed four completions deliberately hold the accepted target and witnessed atoms fixed while allowing the missing local valve output to vary independently of the true affine family. That is a legitimate ATOMS_ONLY model-class ablation only if the future model in that cell cannot reconstruct the schema from retained atoms, public grammar, descriptor labels, same-descriptor confirmer, or reader metadata. Freeze exactly which grammar and roots are removed, prove four equal visible-byte completions, and separately report actual legal-history/program value 1 and ablation value 1/4.

concerns.statement: OPEN_READ has no world-level ceiling: direct family-to-fact queries under six reads solve the proposed three-fact targets, while the opaque two-hop locator makes the precommitted arm fail by withholding addresses until after commitment.
concerns.evidence: The proposed recurrent policy spends exactly six reads on three locator/fact chains. An open policy that must commit all six anchors before receiving any locator obtains no semantic atom; with a direct index it can query the two setter families and valve family and attain value 1. Thus the contrast isolates sequential pointer following under a deliberately address-dependent API, not an information-theoretic need for recurrent memory. This can be a fair narrow baseline because the existing G1 contract permits already-returned candidate IDs, but only if the exact candidate universe, anchor grammar, return order, tie rule, read/token costs, origin capabilities, and policy class are ratified and shared. Add interface ablations showing direct-index OPEN=1, typed recurrent two-hop=1, and precommitted two-hop at the derived prior value. Limit any positive claim to adaptive retrieval through this pinned interface; do not generalize it to open retrieval or connected memory broadly.

concerns.statement: The at-least-.85 CPU headroom language can hide invalid items and conflates deterministic information sufficiency with the later stochastic G1_C_REC model threshold.
concerns.evidence: For a finite deterministic world, every J/P item on both sides must have a nine-action success of value 1 under LEGAL_HISTORY, PROGRAM/SCHEMA_GOLD, and a typed CONNECTED_GOLD controller using the exact six-read and 32-operation interface. Any miss is an instrument or interface defect, not acceptable noise. The consensus must inherit or restate the full action law, failure-as-zero semantics, nine-versus-ten-action value rule, one wrong-RUN terminality, canonical ties, and exact minimality. It must enumerate all successful plans through the cap, not replay one chosen plan, and establish direct-record closure zero plus all old/current environmental cuts. Reserve .85 only for the separately authorized generic model DEV gate.

concerns.statement: The phrase 'no rejection or replacement' is ambiguous and can contradict the requirement that the four DEV world-life pairs are independent; the exact 64-item crossing and failure-retention schedule is also not in the change bytes.
concerns.evidence: The unchanged G1 contract requires four independent pair-level units, two twin sides, and four J plus four P targets per side, giving 4*2*(4+4)=64 items per all-strata cell; targets, sides, calls, and seeds are nested. Sampling orbit representatives without replacement induces dependence between pairs. The proper rule is four independent with-replacement draws from separately namespaced tapes, while forbidding post-draw replacement after a duplicate, generation failure, target failure, or scientific dispatch. Freeze all item/cell/side/seed crossings, include wrong-twin forks on every item, and report pair-level results. Four targets from one world or four target pairs in one chronology are not four units.

concerns.statement: The requirement that constructive successes 'survive twin substitution' reads as continued correctness under wrong memory, which is the opposite of world-specific experiential binding.
concerns.evidence: Authentic and wrong-twin targets are byte-identical, while tau changes both useful J items and the decisive valve mode. A typed controller given matched wrong-twin connected memory should therefore choose incompatible decisive facts and score zero or change the decisive plan; continued correct success suggests the memory was unnecessary, an unchanged decisive fact leaked, or the twin was malformed. Replace the phrase with an exact wrong-twin harm/action-change criterion. Run it on every item, require typed wrong-twin value 0 where the complete wrong plan is deterministic, and for the future model report unconditional substitution outcomes plus the predeclared at-least-.80 loss or decisive-action-change rate among authentic C_REC successes. Do not count mere parser runnability as survival.

concerns.statement: T01 is temporally impossible as written and one co-mutation cannot substitute for a structurally independent, prebound oracle closure.
concerns.evidence: Subject/oracle byte agreement and rejection of a subject mutation require an implemented subject, so they cannot be complete 'before implementation.' Before implementation, ratify and freeze the literal oracle specification, expected vectors, record boundary, source manifest, and mutation preimage; after implementation and before any model dispatch, run agreement and mutation rejection without changing oracle bytes. The oracle must import no subject code, generated tables, renderer, transition function, planner, schema validator, or expected digest; it should use independent canonical parsing and literal GF(2)/action tables, communicate only by canonical records, and have a separately tracked manifest and loaded-source trace. A valve-law co-mutation is a useful minimum kill, but independence is established primarily by the disjoint closure and should also cover target rendering, tau, chronology, and planning seams within the small scope.

concerns.statement: Running a CPU planner in a disposable clone proves only that CPU path's noninterference unless it uses the exact future G1-facing reader, parser, action executor, snapshot boundary, and audit sink.
concerns.evidence: The actual G1 evaluator will add prompt construction, condition assignment, model output parsing, recurrent reader state, operation budgets, caches, and per-cell reset behavior. None exists in this design and no model call is authorized. D0 should run the exact model-facing non-model components with a deterministic typed controller and label the result CPU_INTERFACE_ISOLATION; R1 must later bind and test the complete G1 runner before dispatch. On the chosen target host, mount source/generator/oracle/scorer code out of reach, make the snapshot OS-read-only, provide a private writable workspace, validate nonempty receipts independently, discard outputs, regenerate both suffixes from the original snapshot, and compare source, target, commitment, reader store/index, handle/cursor, cache, and root bytes. An unavailable real backend is NOT_RUN, not a synthetic pass.

concerns.statement: Independent 48-bit locator draws make successful guessing unlikely but not impossible; an exact OPEN_READ theorem needs origin-checked capabilities, not a cryptographic-probability assertion.
concerns.evidence: A model can emit any syntactically valid 48-bit string. If validity depends only on membership in the hidden index, a guess can collide, and return timing or NOT_FOUND patterns expose index structure. The reader must accept a locator only when that exact capability was previously emitted to the same evaluator instance, with a sealed per-item origin ledger; target-visible handles may be initial capabilities, newly returned locators become capabilities only after their read, and cross-side/cell/life locators are rejected identically. Freeze constant-shape error bytes, ordering, latency/candidate-work accounting, collision handling, and duplicate-query semantics. The oracle must enumerate capability state as part of the policy state.

concerns.statement: The four-stage visibility matrix is too coarse to prevent hidden truth, side identity, selection metadata, or outcomes from reaching cognitive bytes through renderers and infrastructure.
concerns.evidence: Add explicit stages for target constructor/renderer, handle allocator, source comparer, gold compiler, reader index and candidate generator, prompt builder, condition assigner, parser, evaluator, audit sink, and suffix generator. Forbid hidden completion, representative/orbit role, pair/side, accepted attempt, law ID, correct item/mode, proof, posterior mass, score, condition, and prior outcome from every visible handle, order, phrase, length, candidate/rank, timing, retry, parser repair, or resource-dependent branch. The oracle may receive hidden truth only after targets, memory projections, controller outputs, and evaluator receipts freeze, and it must have no write path back. Generation must complete before G1 arm assignment or result exists.

concerns.statement: Four world-life pairs are a useful fail-fast engineering screen but cannot estimate a population, and repeated targets or decoding seeds do not increase the independent sample size.
concerns.evidence: One pair can move an equal-pair mean by .25, all four J/P target ordinals within a side share laws and life history, and prompt/parser choices are DEV-tuned. Freeze a pair-level, stratum-specific stop/redesign/request-next-stage rule before outcomes; retain failures and duplicates; average nested samples within pair; report every pair; and prohibit p-values, confidence intervals, population language, paper-result language, G2 release, or retrospective target/prompt repair. A positive screen may request a larger separately ratified stage only. This preserves the paper ROI: delete N/O/R/X, production roster/release schemas, broad mutation machinery, and cross-platform containment, but do not delete the corrected hidden-space theorem, exact reader interface, independent oracle, wrong-twin/cut controls, or real target-host isolation.

concerns.statement: The proposed 2,500-line, 10-second, 256-MiB, 100,000-edge, ten-day, and two-week limits are useful ROI constraints only after their counting domains and target host are frozen, and exceeding them must cause redesign rather than approximation.
concerns.evidence: Count all executable subject and oracle source under one exact logical-line rule, all subject-plus-oracle transition edges, aggregate child RSS, actual temporary and sealed bytes, and the maximum concurrent worker count. Bind the OS backend and strict inequality semantics before implementation. If the corrected era-local world, literal oracle, or real interface cannot fit, the honest response is to simplify noncausal machinery or stop the path; it is never permission to prune positive-mass completions, lower value-1 headroom, weaken a shortcut threshold, use a self-oracle, simulate isolation, or revive Candidate B by inertia.

visibility_failures: The proposal does not yet forbid hidden completion, orbit representative, pair/side, useful role, or law identity from influencing target family selection, handle allocation, ordering, phrasing, length, retries, or errors.

A syntactically valid 48-bit locator is treated as unguessable instead of requiring a same-evaluator prior-emission capability, leaving a probabilistic hidden-index channel in an allegedly exact reader.
The D11 confirmer may expose the target-relevant abstract output through public history before target evaluation even when the held-out local family has no direct outcome.
Reader candidate universes, ranks, return order, NOT_FOUND bytes, timing, parser repair, and resource-driven retries are not represented in the visibility matrix.

The oracle's hidden-truth access is not ordered after the freeze of target bytes, memory projections, all registered controller decisions, evaluator receipts, and G1-facing interface bytes with a proven no-write-back edge.
The run/skip contract does not yet cover model-facing reader/index state, prompt/condition assignment state, per-cell caches, and locator-origin ledgers.
missing_acceptance_tests: MJP_D0_T07_J_ERA_LOCAL_INFORMATION_CUT: independently compute old-only and current-only history posteriors and action values on both sides, prove neither history determines the other era's decisive mapping, and kill a mutation that globalizes an era-local orientation.

MJP_D0_T08_EXACT_GENERATOR_MEASURE_AND_FIXED_DECK_DIAGNOSTIC: enumerate sampler/orbit/side/target-render masses conditioned on complete visible bytes, prove the ex-ante Bayes action and value, and separately report scores of frozen preregistered policies on the realized four-pair deck without post-hoc handle memorization.

MJP_D0_T09_PROSPECTIVE_NO_SAME_DESCRIPTOR_CLOSURE: prove commitment and held-out target-template seals precede all relevant outcomes, the held-out family has no outcome/status append, and no pretarget confirmer or public grammar plus atoms determines its D11 mode.

MJP_D0_T10_READER_INTERFACE_FAIRNESS_AND_CAPABILITY_ORIGIN: compare direct-index open, two-hop precommitted open, and two-hop typed recurrent policies under identical budgets; enumerate locator-origin state and reject guesses, cross-item handles, and timing/error channels.

MJP_D0_T11_WRONG_TWIN_DIRECTIONAL_BINDING: on every J/P item verify authentic typed connected gold value 1, matched wrong-twin value 0 or an exact incompatible decisive-plan change, and record unconditional plus authentic-success-conditioned future model rates.

MJP_D0_T12_FOUR_PAIR_64_ITEM_MANIFEST: verify four independent with-replacement pair draws from disjoint tape namespaces, two sides and four J plus four P targets per pair, full cell/seed crossing, duplicate retention, and no replacement after any failure or dispatch.

MJP_D0_T13_MODEL_FACING_CPU_PATH_ISOLATION: execute the exact reader, parser, action executor, snapshot, reset, and audit path later used by G1 with a deterministic controller, require nonempty independently correct receipts, and byte-compare every suffix and interface state against skip.
human_questions: Should the 96-world proposal be rejected in favor of era-local conditioner orientations, nominally 16 orientation assignments times 24 valve laws = 384 worlds, unless consensus supplies another exact same-era-nonclosure proof?

Will the owner ratify the opaque two-hop locator as the scientific treatment itself and accept the narrow claim 'adaptive pointer-following under this pinned reader,' with direct-index OPEN=1 reported as a fairness diagnostic?
Should the P chronology forbid any same-law D11 confirmer before held-out D11 target evaluation, using other-descriptor later roots for support instead?

Confirm that DEV retains four independently sampled world-life pairs, two twin sides, four J and four P targets per side (64 items per all-strata cell), mandatory wrong-twin forks, and no post-failure replacement.
Confirm that exact value 1 is required itemwise for legal-history, program/schema, and typed connected-gold controls, while .85 is reserved only for the later generic model gate.
Which one target-host OS containment backend and exact line/RSS/edge/temp/sealed-byte counting rules are authorized for the minimal timebox?

Confirm that this adjudication remains design-only: no implementation, model, network, GPU, G1 dispatch, or paper claim is authorized until corrected exact bytes and scope receive separate human ratification.
